name: Far From Paradise
source:
Far From Paradise is a coming-of-age mystery visual novel set in a quiet town where things aren't as pleasant as they seem.

Perched inside the mountains of the American Southwest during the 1990s, the town of Paradise is a place where everyone knows each other- and where outsiders are a rare sight. Lately, the familiar normalcy of day-to-day has begun to feel off.

People disappearing.

A massive flower field in a desert that appeared overnight.

No one seems to have a clear answer why.

You follow a small group of high school seniors- Angel, Skye, and Marie, as they approach the end of their final school year together. Their unease turns into something far more personal- as the change of the town affects them in more ways than they'd expect. Follow their perspectives as their lives warp around them.

[From [url=https://nemophila-dreams.itch.io/far-from-paradise]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《远离天堂》是一部成长悬疑视觉小说，故事发生在一个安静的小镇，那里的一切并不像看上去那么令人愉快。

天堂镇坐落于20世纪90年代美国西南部的山区，是一个人人都互相认识的地方，而且很少见到外人。最近，熟悉的日常生活开始变得不那么正常了。

人消失了。

一夜之间，沙漠中出现了一片巨大的花田。

似乎没有人能给出明确的答案。

你跟随一小群高中生——安吉尔、斯凯和玛丽，他们一起临近最后一个学年的结束。他们的不安变成了更加个人化的事情——因为城镇的变化对他们的影响比他们预想的要多。当他们的生活围绕着他们扭曲时，跟随他们的观点。

[来自[url=https://nemophila-dreams.itch.io/far-from-paradise]Itch.io[/url]]
